title: Source/Authority/Originality Boundary & Microgame Taxonomy
objective: Implement only the governed source/authority/originality boundary and reusable microgame taxonomy needed to classify future MAL interactions before any runtime primitive or playable-loop implementation.

rules: Recovered RDC-01/RD-01/RD-02 and small-interaction/transition/spacewalk material is provenance and inspiration only; it grants no authority to copy proprietary game logic, ROM data, maps, scripts, audiovisual assets, names, rule tables or level layouts.

MAL-01 may classify an interaction as micro-interaction, microgame or ambient-loop and tag an authored experience context, but it defines no input, timing, movement, combat, NPC, reward or result mechanics.

Action/Event, Character, Project, World/Scene, ISE, MAI, AAI, GCL and content-owner domains remain canonical. MAL classifications reference those owners and never create parallel Combat, Inventory, Project, Travel or progression truth.

Proposal records never become canonical merely by classification. Owner-authored definitions remain definitions; canonical outcome truth remains in the owning domain and is referenced, not duplicated.

Originality review is conservative: uncertain similarity or proprietary dependence becomes owner-review-required; explicit copying/import of proprietary logic or assets becomes prohibited-copying-pattern.
Generic interaction concepts may be recomposed only as original MAL designs with stable MAL IDs, explicit source provenance and owner-domain references.
AI may propose classifications and original combinations but cannot approve originality, commit outcomes, canonize content or invent governing mechanics.
Unknown or conflicting authority stays unresolved and never defaults to MAL ownership.

invalidation_events: required validation reports a materially new failure signature

convergence_control.retry_basis: Restored required service_objective fields and sealed maintenance-history alignment after exact Repository Health evidence.

validation_requirement: Exactly one MAL-01 current-family profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows acceptance RED before production mutation, then exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison.
